name: miller
description: Local SQLite-backed code intelligence, content search, and workspace freshness for coding agents. Requires Node.js on PATH (the plugin launcher is a Node script).

interface.shortDescription: Local code intelligence for agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Miller provides a local SQLite-backed MCP server and CLI for symbol search, source/docs/content search, web and large-file imports, symbol inspection, context packing, trace paths, impact analysis, edits, workspace freshness checks, telemetry, and JSON/JSONL export contracts.
